eod.conclusion: Indian equities retreated after failing to sustain early gains, with both major benchmarks closing lower. The session saw initial optimism fade as volatility concerns resurfaced, though mid-day trading had shown promise following a sharp drop in the fear index. Regulatory developments around IPOs and payment systems emerged alongside global market weakness, while domestic attention turned toward upcoming earnings reports. Market infrastructure resilience proposals underscored long-term stability efforts amid the day's pullback.
